# Pixel art upscaler

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/pixel-upscaler/

Enlarge pixel art with nearest-neighbor scaling. Choose a whole-number multiplier to preserve its crisp block structure instead of smoothing it.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Scale a 32-pixel sprite to 128 pixels with a four-times enlargement.

## Limits and checks

This is pixel-preserving resizing, not AI enhancement. It does not invent detail missing from a photograph.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
